facts.label: Revisão: pedidos, ofertas e perguntas indiretas
facts.sub: Use Could I/we have… para pedir, Shall I… ou Would you like me to… para oferecer e Could you tell me if/where… para perguntar com educação.

facts.label: Poderia…?
facts.sub: Use Could I have… ou Could we have… para pedir com educação: Could we have a table by the window, please? Depois de could, vem o verbo base.

facts.label: Quer que eu…?
facts.sub: Use Shall I + verbo base para oferecer ajuda: Shall I bring the menu now? Would you like me to + verbo também oferece: Would you like me to bring extra sauce?

compare.ask: Could you tell me how much it costs?
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “você poderia me dizer se tem carne?”.
compare.tip: Diga: “Could you tell me how much it costs?”
compare.us: Em inglês, Could you tell me if… + frase normal: Could you tell me if the soup has meat? Depois de if ou da palavra de pergunta, a ordem é de afirmação.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: Could you tell me how much it costs?
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: A restaurant in Glasgow · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday night in a busy restaurant in Glasgow. Nina has come to dinner with two friends. Bree is the waitress who shows them the way. The room smells of fresh bread and soup. Nina wants a quiet table. She has a few polite questions.

“Good evening, Nina. Can I take your coat?” says Bree. “Thank you. Could we have a table by the window, please?” says Nina. “Of course. Shall I bring the menu now? Would you like some water?” says Bree.
